references.text: The penalty for uncovering the nakedness of one's father's wife is stated here, expanding on the prohibition in Lev 18:7
Prohibition against uncovering the father's nakedness by lying with his wife; a parallel theme concerning family honor
Cursing anyone who dishonors their father or mother, related to respect for parents
Ezekiel condemns those who uncover the father's nakedness, a direct reference to this prohibition
The command to honor father and mother forms the moral foundation for the prohibition against sexual sin toward parents
Continuation of the theme prohibiting the uncovering of one's father's wife's nakedness
Paul condemns a man in Corinth who is living with his father's wife, an violation of this prohibition
